title: Plastics - Methods of Testing, Part 10: Resin (Thermosetting Properties), Section 7: Phenol-Formaldehyde Mouldings - Determination of Acetone-Soluble Matter (Apparent Resin Content of Material
clause_1_scope: This standard describes a method for the measurement of gloss of plastic films and solid plastics, both opaque and transparent. It contains three separate gloss angles: a) 60?, recommended for intermediate-gloss films; b) 20°, recommended for high-gloss films; and c) 45?, recommended for intermediate and lowgloss films.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
